article.headline: Grant Stubblefield scores 18 to guide Omaha to 67-56 victory over Lindenwood
article.description: — Grant Stubblefield had 18 points to guide Omaha to a 67-56 victory over Lindenwood on Friday night.
article.linkText: Grant Stubblefield scores 18 to guide Omaha to 67-56 victory over Lindenwood
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Grant Stubblefield had 18 points to guide Omaha to a 67-56 victory over Lindenwood on Friday night. Stubblefield also had eight rebounds and six assists for the Mavericks (3-2). Deke Thompson added 14 points and six rebounds. Cahmai Crosby scored 10. Marsai Mason led the Lions (2-3) with 12 points and 11 rebounds. Xavier Spencer and Shamiere Green both scored 11. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
